description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'OpenmrsPropertyEditor' that extends 'PropertyEditorSupport' for converting between String representations and OpenmrsObject instances, used for property editing in OpenMRS. It includes methods to resolve objects by ID or UUID and manage conversion to and from text.

classes.name: OpenmrsPropertyEditor
classes.description: An abstract class providing property editing capabilities for OpenmrsObject-based objects, allowing conversion between object and text representations, utilizing object ID and UUID lookups.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve an OpenmrsObject instance by its numeric ID.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve an OpenmrsObject instance by its UUID string.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a String input into an OpenmrsObject, first trying to interpret it as an ID, then as a UUID if the ID lookup fails.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Returns the String representation (ID as string) of the current OpenmrsObject value, or empty string if null.
